facts.fact: The Ministry of Communication Technologies said on 21 March 2024 that the E-Houwiya mobile digital identity app can be downloaded from app stores, used for e-signature with the citizen's certificate and keys.

A Ministry of Communication Technologies director said the digital identity gives access to many administrative services with one identity, including portals of the social affairs, interior and state property ministries.

E-Houwiya, a mobile digital identity tied to the citizen's unique identifier, is available to Tunisians aged 18 or over holding a national ID card, and was used for remote school and university enrolment.
